description: PJ-004 AC-13 (M1 scope): deterministic look fixture. Deltas are generated in the test from `seed` with RandomNumberGenerator (uniform in +-max_delta_deg per axis, degrees, input convention +right/+up). `zone_notice_steps` are physics steps where a zone-activated notice arrives; it must not change the orientation. Door, blackout, call, reflection and P1-hint events are added when those systems exist.
